title: Toxtricity - Rare Holo - Phantasmal Flames - Pokemon TCG -  068/094
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card featuring Toxtricity from the Phantasmal Flames set. This rare holo card is numbered 068/094 and illustrated by Shigenori Negishi. Manufactured by The Pokémon Company, the card is in English and has a darkness attribute. It is a Stage 1 Pokémon card made of card stock, with a standard size and a holo finish. This collectible card is perfect for fans of the Pokémon TCG looking to enhance their collection with a unique and sought-after addition.
